about.title: About
about.purpose: A game for learning to identify birds by their song, with short lessons and spaced repetition. This first version focuses on common and iconic species of Valle del Cauca and Cauca, Colombia.
about.disclaimer: The species list and common names are being reviewed with local ornithologists; Spanish names may vary by region.
about.xc: All songs come from xeno-canto, a community sharing bird sounds from around the world. Audio is streamed directly from their site.
about.license: Each recording belongs to its author and is shared under a Creative Commons license they chose. After every question we show the author, the license and a link to the original recording. Many licenses are non-commercial (NC): please respect them if you reuse the audio.
about.privacy: No accounts and no servers of our own. Your progress is stored only in this browser.
